physical_page_semantics: one-based physical PDF page indices; printed page labels are not physical bindings

adjudications.source_grounded_explanation: Physical page 10 is a preceding political-pressure page and does not contain the claim. Physical page 12 contains the Q5 base 268 and minus-43-percent expectation, the Chartbeat decline figures, the uncertainty about AI Overviews, and the zero-click-search context. The final reviewer wording is source-supported on physical page 12.

Physical page 39 is the preceding product-development page and does not contain the browser claim. Physical page 41 contains the Browser wars and agentic apps section, the browser and briefing capabilities, the liquid-content interpretation, and Q15's 60-percent plus 15-percent impact values on base 265. The final reviewer wording is source-supported on physical page 41.

Physical page 34 provides global introductory context, while physical page 35 contains the global and regional install/session growth figures used by the final wording. Physical pages 36, 37, and 38 contain the session, retention, CPI, and paid-versus-organic relationships. The reviewer set is a sufficient smaller source set for its final claim; page 34 is not required.

Physical page 4 is a contents page and physical page 5 does not contain the segment-growth chart. More importantly, the retained reviewer wording reverses the page-6 segment bindings: 128 billion and 5.7 percent belong to cost of Internet access, while 66 billion and 2.3 percent belong to paid content. Page reconciliation cannot approve this materially incorrect final wording.
